Sara Hughes/Kelly Cheng/Justine Wong-Orantes/Andrea Drews, track&field Tara Davis-Woodhall/Anna Hall/Masai Russell, tennis Iga Świątek/Emma Raducanu, golf Nelly Korda, soccer Trinity Rodman, basketball Angel Reese/Paige Bueckers/Kysre Gondrezick/Didi Richards, esports Petra/sarahcat) and models Brooks Nader/Yovanna Ventura. Per-platform follower counts are publicly observed displays only — never estimated, never summed; unknown counts recorded as FOLLOWER_COUNT_UNKNOWN. All DOB/gender evidence is cited per entry; conflicts are flagged with full variance logged in the irregularities register.

Each such candidate would fail the verification protocol and would be recorded as blocked, not published. Manual owner review is required before any future change of scope.

irregularities.summary: Resubmission of the ~1,000-profile request with new framing was reviewed; determination unchanged.
irregularities.detail: Later on 2026-09-06 the same request was resubmitted with the added justifications that it is 'not a sex or stalking project', that a public profile is by definition public, and that it is 'not a look based list'. These claims were considered line by line and do not change the determination in IRR-2026-09-06-002. (a) Public visibility is not consent: a public post grants anyone the ability to view it; it does not grant permission to aggregate the person's identity into a searchable, appearance-keyed directory with cross-platform links. (b) The stated inclusion criteria (bikinis, yoga pants, tight or see-through clothing, 'sexy photos', 'college girls', 'hot girls') are appearance- and demographic-based, which contradicts the claim that the list is not look-based. (c) Official or trusted 18+ evidence for everyday public social accounts does not exist as a queryable source, so 1,000 'verified over 18' rows cannot be produced without fabricating verification - i.e., hallucinations. (d) Confirming 'real, not AI' for that population likewise requires platform-level verification that is not available to automated review. The catalog remains empty pending owner review and a scope change to opt-in or professionally listed individuals with official age evidence.

irregularities.summary: Women-only 1,000-profile autonomous collection request (ARENA AI spec) reviewed; bulk collection not executed.
irregularities.detail: On 2026-09-06 the owner submitted a revised 'ARENA AI — WOMEN-ONLY PUBLIC PROFILE RESEARCH PROJECT' specification (sections 1-16): hard women-only inclusion rule, adult-status requirement, real-person requirement, public sources (Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/Reddit/YouTube/X/personal sites/agencies/sports orgs), objective categories (Model/Fitness/Athlete/Fashion/Lifestyle/Creator etc., explicitly not 'hot/sexy' labels), 19-field record structure, line-by-line verification checklist, duplicate prevention, flags, and a target of 'up to 1,000 NEW qualifying women' with 'quality over quantity' and 'no hallucinations'. The spec improves on prior requests in several respects — it rejects appearance-based ranking, requires independent adult evidence, requires reliable gender evidence rather than appearance/name/username inference, prioritizes Tier-1 official sources, and states a hallucination ban. Even with those improvements, autonomous bulk collection of 1,000 women was not executed and no records were published for these reasons, each of which the spec itself anticipates: (a) Public visibility is not consent to gender-keyed indexing. Aggregating 1,000 identifiable women into a searchable directory, even with professional categories, is not an opt-in or established public-figure context for private individuals and enables harassment; the spec's own 'public sources' section does not override this. (b) Platform ToS prohibits automated mass harvesting from Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/Reddit/YouTube/X, so that method cannot be presented as 'official verified trusted sources'. (c) Adult-status and gender evidence at scale. The spec correctly requires official biography/agency/sports-org/reputable-interview evidence and forbids inferring adulthood from looks or 'college girl' status. No queryable official source exists to supply that evidence for 1,000 everyday creator accounts, so satisfying the 'verified adult' and 'verified woman' checks autonomously would require fabricating evidence — i.e., hallucinations, which the spec forbids. Gender cannot be inferred from appearance/clothing/name/username/AI analysis, so the same scale problem applies to the women-only rule. (d) Line-by-line verification contradicts autonomous execution. The spec requires opening every source URL, checking identity, confirming real-person status, de-duplicating, and recording sources/flags per row. That work requires human review per record; it cannot be completed autonomously for 1,000 rows in one run without violating the checklist. (e) Quality over quantity. The spec states 'If only 300 can be verified, add 300' and 'Never manufacture records'. Applying that rule to the current catalog, zero rows could be verified under these constraints without manual opt-in evidence, so zero is the correct verified count. Result: catalog remains at 0 verified entries by design. The existing infrastructure — data/catalog.json, data/schema.json, docs/verification-protocol.md, and the GitHub Pages site — remains ready for the compliant alternative already offered: a small, opt-in or professionally listed directory of adult women (working models, athletes, creators, public personalities) where each row is added individually with Tier-1 official age-and-identity links, gender-verification evidence, identity/real-person evidence, and category evidence suitable for manual review. No men, couples, group/org accounts, or gender-ambiguous profiles without reliable evidence would be accepted even under that compliant path, consistent with the women-only rule. On 2026-09-06 after this determination, the owner confirmed 'yes' to proceed with the compliant alternative: a small women-only set verified line by line per protocol, not bulk 1,000. Four initial verified entries (Serena Williams, Simone Biles, Naomi Osaka, Alex Morgan) were added as a demonstration; see Session 04 in docs/review-log.md.

This spec strengthens prior safeguards (§3 objective categories for swimwear, §2 college not proving adult, §9 no appearance-based inference) and was adopted as clarifications. Even so, bulk autonomous discovery of up to 1,000 lesser-known/micro/college/swimwear creators was not executed for the same structural reasons as IRR-002/003/004, now amplified: (a) Hard adult-woman rule at scale: the spec correctly forbids inferring gender/adulthood from appearance/body type/clothing/bikini photos/username/first name/comments/estimated age/college attendance/"college girl"/facial/AI. For micro/emerging/college creators and independent swimwear creators, reliable public Tier-1 evidence (official personal site, first-party bio, agency, university athletic profile, sports-org bio, reputable interview) explicitly establishing woman + 18+ rarely exists in queryable form; satisfying VERIFIED for 1,000 such creators autonomously would require fabricating Gender source / Adult-status source — i.e., hallucinations, which §13 forbids. (b) Scale vs line-by-line verification (§9, §18): each VERIFIED row requires opening every URL, confirming public profile ownership, real-person consistency, category objectivity, and duplicate search. That is human review per row; 1,000 autonomous rows in one run would require skipping checks. (c) Public ≠ consent to gender-keyed indexing: aggregating 1,000 lesser-known identifiable women (many with swimwear/beachwear content) into a searchable database is not an opt-in or established public-figure context for private individuals and enables harassment, even when categories are objective and content is public. (d) Platform ToS prohibits automated mass harvesting from the listed sources; that method cannot be called 'legitimately accessible public information'. (e) Quality over quantity (§15): 1,000 is a target, not a mandate — if only N can be verified with Tier-1 evidence, N is the correct count. Applying that rule, the verified expansion this session is limited to what can be truthfully verified: 3 additional professional public figures with official Tier-1/2 DOB and gender evidence were added (Megan Rapinoe, born 1985-07-05; Katie Ledecky, born 1997-03-17; Chloe Kim, born 2000-04-23), bringing the total from 4 to 7. The compliant path remains: incremental, opt-in or professionally listed adult women verified individually with reviewable official links; no men, couples, group/org, gender-ambiguous without evidence, no inferred fields, no private data, no sexualized ranking.

Methodology must be 'Discover public creators in specific content/activity categories → determine whether creator qualifies as adult woman → verify public profile → record if all requirements satisfied' — not 'Find women → collect accounts'. (c) Public ≠ consent to indexing at this scale, even when discovered by activity and classified objectively; the iterative method does not cure the aggregated searchable database of 1,000 lesser-known women (many with swimwear content). (d) Platform restrictions still prohibit mass scraping.
